stage: Source metadata inspection before candidate single-cell expression analysis
observation: GSE159115 ccRCC_anno and normal_anno sample assignments conflict with GEO SOFT tissue characteristics for several paired samples; patient identifiers agree
decision: Preserve author cohort labels and GEO tissue fields separately; label tumor cells as author-annotated, not independently CNV-confirmed. Audit barcode and UMI joins. Do not silently overwrite source metadata
interpretation: Normal epithelial expression and tumor-normal comparisons from discordant cohorts are descriptive and source-label-dependent. Concordant normal donors may be too few for any confirmatory tumor-normal contrast
stop_rule: Reject duplicate/missing barcode joins or inconsistent donor identifiers; if raw and annotation UMI totals disagree, investigate before using the sample
